meta.title: Queen House — Silence and Lori mountains
meta.description: Two A-frame wooden cabins in Vardablur, Lori, Armenia. Heated jacuzzi, fire pit, Wi-Fi. Call to book.

about.title: Show must go on. In Lori.
about.p1: Queen House is two A-frame wooden cabins in Vardablur village, Lori province of Armenia. Forests, Dzoraget canyon, and Stepanavan nearby — reasons to come and stay.
about.p2: The name and logo are a quiet tribute to Queen and Freddie Mercury. We believe a great stay should feel like a show where you are the headliner.

house1.name: House №1 — The Crown
house1.description: A-frame cabin with heated jacuzzi and forest view.

house2.name: House №2 — The Mercury
house2.description: Intimate cabin with fire pit area and mountain view.
